content: KAYAKNU DANAB AH DILAG KOLEKTA
Gemu am da ag men doḏo qag mena, Kayaknu danab ah maṯaglagnu heṯeb amunu aḵulnu heṯem. Da tatam Galata kristen tamaniak ib ip̱uanaṯi heṯeb amubia ag ele anam heḵulagnu aṯem.

Meṯid ohp̱a ag oh anen anen meṯid laanu deḏp̱a men doḏo aop̱ig amu dab meṯanna, ag laih otin, laulagp̱a mep̱eg dayebeb, geha dimp̱a da gumaṯe gop̱i amu ag men doḏo maṯaglagnu maṯiak henana, hik ii aqama.

Aria da dimp̱a ahilagp̱a gop̱i amu ag aḵa danab laala ag men doḏo amu aon, Jerusalem goḵulagnu otiadp̱eg amu, da Jerusalem danab ag danab ag otiadp̱ig ele amu, ag ag doyadḵulagnu da ag pas madap̱i, ag amu ele aon goḵulag.
Aria da ele goḵulnu dayeb amu ag da ele oh goḵunig.
BAG QAK NAI
Dimp̱a da tatam Makedonia gamag oḵule uḵen amu geha ahilagp̱a ana teḵul. Ao, da geha tatam Makedonia gamagp̱a oiḵul.
Am geha da ag ele haen nakok tutuibtai ana daagnigtai, o iiṯa da ag ele daap̱ut uḵeb, oug haen iiṯa meeb, dimp̱a am da ab laap̱a goḵulnu hebip̱i amu ag da omaiḏna gona, ibp̱a uuiḏḵulag.
Da gemu Makedonia uḵena, ahilagp̱a tep̱i, haen tutuib nug iḏu anidḵunignu ool ii daaṯe. Iiṯa. Naḏi Nug ab amu da ag ele haen nakok elab daagnig.
Amge da Epesus daap̱p̱i uḵeb, Penitkos deḏ doḵu.
Aḏinu? Kayak Nug dahil ib amu matu ma babaiṯom daaṯe am da uḏat naḏi, danab ah kuḏum ehanadp̱i, kristen daaglagnu heṯem. Amge kekeḏ ele kuḏum daaṯeb.
Am geha dimp̱a Timotius, nug Naḏinu uḏat da heṯem amubia heṯe ele amunu, nug ahilagp̱a teeb amu ag tutuḵu dab mep̱eg, nug geha oo maḏoḏ ele ag oolagp̱a dayaḏ!

Amunu laa nug nuhignu keeke hamu bia dab maama aib di meṯom. Iiṯa. Ag hep̱eg, nug oop̱a maḏoḏ dayebeb aria dimp̱a ag nug ibp̱a omalp̱eg amu nug da gumiḏa uḏiḵu. Da nug ameg meiyi, lailad laala oh ele daaṯem.

Aria ig lainig Apolos, nuhignu amu da iiḵu aṯem. Haen kuḏum da nug amegp̱a, nug geha uḵebeb, lailad laala ele oh gona, ag anadḵulagnu ami amge nug gemu goḵunu am uua autanab awom. Dimp̱a nug haen anṯa amu aria nug geha goḵu.
Ag Korint danab ag ib apiḏidna eheḏ gomananu amu ag dab meṯan autna aona, ag ahilag oop̱a genab doyakp̱a g̱agaṯag ahan daan, ag danab genab daanna amu ag g̱agaṯag ele dayeg!
Ag keeke oh henana, ag oo mauhak doonna ag heig!

O lailad, ag Stepanus amu nug baeḵudp̱anu ele, ag am Grik oolagp̱anu ag tatam kristen bena, ag aḵa Kayaknu danab ehanadḵulagnu oolag daye, uḏat amu aop̱ig amu ag dooṯeb. Amu da ag inam heḵulagnu aṯem.
Ag danab anam amu dab maṯanna, ag aḏi nai madiṯeb ele amu ag dim lamidna, aria danab laala ag danab amu ele uḏat heṯeb amu ag ahilagnu ele anam heig!
Stepanus, Portunatus, Akaikas ele ag gumiḏna uḏieg amu da gamal ahom. Aḏinu? Ag Korint am ip̱a ii uḏiṯeb amge ewam imu ag uḏieg, ag ele oh uḏilob bia doyeye
ag da oo maḏoḏ meḏap̱ig. Tatam danab ewam amu ag Korint ap̱a ag ele daanna, ag ag oo maḏoḏ madap̱ig amubia ag da oo maḏoḏ meḏap̱ig amunu ag danab anam amu onilag humeg!
GAMANAṮAK NAI
Kristen tamaniak Asia taliliakp̱anu amu ag, ag Korint daaṯeb ele amu, ag humadṯeb. Akwila, Prisila amu kristen tamaniak a laulahp̱a qag meṯeb ele amu, ag ele ag Naḏi onigp̱a ag humadṯeb.
Kristen lainḵad, ip̱a daaṯeb ele amu, ag oh ele ag humadṯeb. Ig Kayaknu danab ah ihinig kobol op̱ia awak elep̱a ag anen anen ag nug humiṯeg!
Da Paulus, da daḵa da ep̱elp̱a humaṯak nai uḏug imup̱a iiḵu yaaṯem.
Am danab laa nug Naḏinu oo ii mauhṯe, nug padal maḏ! Naḏi, na uḏie!
Naḏi Jesusnu ehaniṯak oḵai hamu megṯe ele amu ahilagp̱a dayaḏ!
Ig Kristus Jesus ele ou qeta daaṯem amu dahil oo mauhak ahilagp̱a dayaḏ!
